episodeTitle.en: This CPO regrets that product management exists | Tom Verrilli (CPO of Whatnot)
episodeTitle.zh: 这位首席产品官希望「产品管理」这个岗位从未出现过｜Whatnot 首席产品官 Tom Verrilli

guestBioOfficial.zh: Tom Verrilli 在 Whatnot 负责产品，此前担任 Twitch 首席产品官，也负责过 Twitter 的产品增长。他熟悉直播和交易平台，习惯顺着卖家与买家的完整行为检验一个功能的效果。
guestBioOfficial.en: Whatnot CPO Tom Verrilli previously led product at Twitch and product growth at Twitter. His experience with marketplaces and live video shapes how he examines a change from both the buyer’s and seller’s sides.

title.en: This CPO regrets that product management exists | Tom Verrilli (CPO of Whatnot)
title.zh: 这位首席产品官希望「产品管理」这个岗位从未出现过｜Whatnot 首席产品官 Tom Verrilli

summary.zh: Tom 边招聘产品经理，边质疑这个岗位为什么存在。Whatnot 的直播卖家可以拿起商品直接介绍，买家却可能因此搜不到它。这个例子把他的用人标准说清楚了：谁能看到被忽略的一方，谁能把问题真正解决？
summary.en: Tom questions the PM role even as he hires for it. A live seller can skip creating a listing, but then buyers cannot find the item through search. That tension makes his hiring philosophy tangible.

insights.title: 听候选人怎么解释一次失败
insights.detail: 如果整段复盘都在讲向谁汇报、哪次会议没开，Tom 还没听到他想听的部分：产品或客户到底出了什么问题？
insights.detailEn: A failure story focused entirely on alignment and escalation tells Tom little about the underlying customer problem.

insights.title: 先查数据定义再谈决策不清
insights.detail: 分类和标注欠账会让团队各自看到不同的问题。资深 PM 的经验有帮助，但组织也得补好数据基础。
insights.detailEn: Poor taxonomy and labeling can make a decision look ambiguous even when an experienced PM is involved.

insights.title: 给卖家省下的工序，可能正是买家搜索的依据
insights.detail: 直播时举起商品就能卖，省去了写商品页的时间。直到成交才知道卖了什么，平台便很难提前把想买 AirPods 的人引到那场直播。
insights.detailEn: Removing listings saves sellers time but strips search of the information needed to direct buyers to the right live stream.
insights.titleEn: A shortcut for sellers can break search
